title: Compressed Air Pipes - Fittings and Pressure Loss
description: Fittings in compressed air pipe lines and equivalent length pressure drop. This calculator helps determine the equivalent pipe length for various fittings in compressed air systems using SI and Imperial units.

components.content:
## Compressed Air Pipes - Fittings and Pressure Loss

Pressure drop in compressed air pipe line fittings can be expressed as equivalent length in meters of pipe line.

### How to Use
Select your unit system (SI or Imperial), choose the nominal pipe size and fitting type to find the equivalent pipe length.

### SI Units Reference Table
Equivalent Pipe Length (m) for various fittings and pipe sizes in SI units.

### Example
A 90° bend in a 50 mm pipe equals approximately 0.6 m of straight pipe line in terms of pressure drop.

### Imperial Units Reference Table
Equivalent Pipe Length (ft) for various fittings and pipe sizes in Imperial units.
